description: This file defines a package 'clockwork' that provides interfaces and implementations for fake and real clocks in Go, primarily for testing purposes. It includes definitions for Clock interface, realClock and FakeClock implementations, and methods for managing timers, tickers, and advancing time.

classes.name: realClock
classes.description: Implementation of Clock interface delegating to the actual time package.

classes.name: FakeClock
classes.description: A manually controllable clock for testing, allowing time to be advanced programmatically.

classes.name: blocker
classes.description: Helper struct used internally to block until a certain number of waiters are registered.

classes.name: expirer
classes.description: Interface for timers or tickers that can expire at a specific time.

classes.name: fakeTimer
classes.description: Internal struct representing a timer in FakeClock (not fully shown in the snippet).

classes.name: fakeTicker
classes.description: Internal struct representing a ticker in FakeClock (not fully shown in the snippet).

methods.name: After
methods.description: Returns a channel that will send the current time after the specified duration on the fake clock.

methods.name: Sleep
methods.description: Blocks until the specified duration has passed on the fake clock.

methods.name: Now
methods.description: Returns the current time of the fake clock.

methods.name: Since
methods.description: Returns the duration since the specified time on the fake clock.

methods.name: Until
methods.description: Returns the duration until the specified time on the fake clock.

methods.name: NewTicker
methods.description: Creates a new ticker that expires after the specified duration, advancing only when the fake clock is manually advanced.

methods.name: NewTimer
methods.description: Creates a new timer that fires after the specified duration, controlled by manual clock advancement.

methods.name: AfterFunc
methods.description: Returns a timer that executes a function after the specified duration, with execution controlled by manual clock advancement.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the fake clock by a specified duration, expiring timers and tickers accordingly.
